resources.string: Enable USB debugging first in the developer options
"'"First reboot"'" must be executed when CoreELEC is started for the first time or after an update of the Android system.
Restarts the device into CoreELEC. To return to Android, just reboot or turn the device off and on as usual.

The CoreELEC boot gate is gone from the bootloader environment, so it has to be rebuilt from scratch.

Android is running on slot %1$s, so CoreELEC should be on slot %2$s. That is only correct if Android has never switched slots via an OTA.

If you are not sure, cancel and run reassert_env_gate.py from a PC instead.
